title: Colorable encoded graph
statement: For natural numbers $v$ and $q$, an encoded graph on the vertex set $\{0,1,\ldots,v-1\}$ is colorable with $q$ colors if its vertices can be assigned colors from a set of $q$ colors so that every adjacent pair receives distinct colors.
